name: Orygen TGD Health Service - headspace Sunshine
title: Youth gender service
description: Victorian Government-funded Orygen service providing safe, gender-affirming care to young people aged 12-25 who are transgender, gender diverse or questioning: gender-affirming medical care including hormone therapy (via GPs and nurses), primary GP care, psychiatry, psychology and peer navigation. Self-referral by contacting the headspace centre (no referral needed); telehealth available. Puberty blockers out of scope; for under-18s it provides assessment for access to gender-affirming hormone therapy.
specialties: Youth gender-affirming care, hormone therapy, peer navigation, mental health
